offers.title: Data Scientist Marketing
offers.description:
At Northwind, we’re on a mission to Make Life Easy for our users by creating the most user-centric banking experience out there. Our paid marketing campaigns run on predictions about which new users will turn out to be valuable. This role makes sure those predictions are right.

That’s where you come in. As our Data Scientist, Marketing, you’ll own the machine learning models that predict the value of every newly verified user and feed that value into Google Ads, so our campaigns find more users like them. If the models are off, the spend is off. AI can help you write and debug code, but it can’t build the model or judge whether the output can be trusted. That judgment is yours.

Take Ownership 🚀

You’ll own the predictive models that steer our marketing spend. Here’s how you’ll do it:

  • Build, maintain and expand the predictive models for marketing, from first idea to production, starting with the models that predict each new user’s value in their first 90 days.

  • Hit the model quality targets within 9 months: a Spearman rank correlation of 0.50 or higher and a binary model AUC of 0.75 or higher.

offers.title: Support Experience Lead
offers.description:
At Northwind, we’re here to make life easy for our users; and that starts with support they can truly trust. When something goes wrong, we don’t pass it around. We own it.
As a Support Team Lead, you’ll play a key role in keeping our promise of premium support, making sure escalations from our Internal AI Agent Finn are handled fast, properly, and never repeated.

Take Ownership

As a Support Team Lead, you will:

  • Own AI Support escalations end-to-end and ensure timely, high-quality resolutions

  • Act as the clear owner for complex issues, bringing clarity and direction when things go wrong

  • Lead, coach, and support a team of ~10 Support Experience Guides

  • Help your team improve decision-making, ownership, and service quality

  • Identify recurring issues and turn them into concrete process improvements

  • Improve and optimize Support processes, tooling, and ways of working

  • Work closely with stakeholders to implement solutions, not just document problems

  • Use AI and automation to improve efficiency and consistency in daily operations

  • Track success through outcomes such as KPIs, backlog health, and user impact

offers.requirements:
As our Collections Expert, you’ll own credit card collections end to end, from the first missed payment to a fair outcome for our users. Automation handles the first contact, and people step in from Day 30.

  • 📋 Make sure certified Support Adams offer standard payment plans correctly, and escalate non-standard cases to the Product Owner Lending

  • 💬 Set the tone for every outreach, so it stays empathetic, clear, and compliant, especially for vulnerable users

  • 🤖 Build AI-powered automation that scales our outreach, with a human in the loop where judgment matters

  • 📊 Track delinquency, recovery, and outreach results, and turn what you find into process improvements

  • ⚖️ Keep every step compliant and fair, working closely with Legal and Risk

  • 🔄 Run the handoff to our collections partner from Day 90, and make sure only cleared cases are referred

This challenge is perfect for you if ✨

  • You have deep expertise in collections strategy and portfolio risk, and you can decide when the picture is unclear

  • You stay calm and empathetic in stressful moments

  • You know debt collection and consumer credit regulations in depth, and you can apply them in gray areas

  • You analyze data and turn it into action

  • You lead across teams and balance competing priorities
